annotations.title: Change a creator campaign or set it live, paused or closed

description: Change a campaign's brief, budget (raise only once live), dates, caps, requirements or hold, and/or move it with status: active (live: creators can join and submit), paused (no new posts; tracking continues), closed (final: nothing new counts; a pool campaign splits its pool among approved posts by views). The payout model and platforms are fixed once live.

brief.description: what to post: the product, the angle, do and do not, links

budgetUsd.description: the most all creators together can earn (required for cpm); can be raised while live

economics.description: the payout model; fixed once live

maxPayoutPerPostUsd.description: cpm: the most one post can earn

minViewsToEarn.description: cpm / pool: views a post needs before it earns

perPostUsd.description: flat: what each approved post earns; cpm: an optional bonus per approved post

poolUsd.description: pool: the amount split among approved posts by their views

ratePer1kUsd.description: cpm: what 1,000 verified views earn, e.g. 1.5

type.description: cpm = per 1,000 verified views; flat = per approved post; pool = a fixed amount split by views at close

holdDays.description: how long approved earnings wait before they can be paid, 0 to 60 (default 10): your window to reject a bad post

joinApproval.description: open = anyone with the link joins; manual = you approve each one

landingUrl.description: an https link creators can point people to

maxPostAgeHours.description: how old a post may be when submitted (default 72)

name.description: what creators see the campaign called

platforms.description: where posts may be published; fixed once live

requirements.description: what each post should carry; a missing one is flagged for you, never auto-rejected

disclosure.description: flag posts with no #ad / paid-partnership label (default true)

startsAt.description: date posts must be published after (default: when it goes live)

trackingDays.description: how long after submission a post's views keep counting, 1 to 365 (default 30)

name: update_creator_campaign
